title: Photo frames
text: Photo frames. Not best quality and wish hot ones at hobby lobby but they did do the job.

product_metadata.title: Jerry & Maggie Family Photo Frame 22x17, Family Picture Frames Collage Wall Decor, 9 Opening 4x6 Picture Frames Family, Wall Hanging For 6x4 Photos 8 Pack Ashes, Required Assembly
features: Function - Wall hanging for pictures 4x6 collage frames, assembly is required and installation tools are provided with the package. After assembled, it can be hung in the bedroom or in the living room. The wall memory display frame is adaptable to various occasions.

Design - 23.5 x18.5 inch hanging picture frames collage wall decor assembled with "3D" staggered visual effect, there are 8 individual frames for picture border width 1 inch, can place 4X6 inch photos, and a card photo frame with the word "FAMILY".

Material - This collage frame is made of MDF material, like wood, which is waterproof and soil-proof, durable and beautiful; the acrylic front cover not only prevents dust, but also prevents photos from being scratched, more durable than glass, and the edges are polished to prevent scratches. You just arrange the photos, put them in and then cover the back cover, you get an all-in-one "3D" family portrait wall decor hanging on the wall of the balcony, and the frame blends in with the home style.

Construction - 8 individual photo frames and a card frame with instructions and installation tool, which shows installation steps and simple instructions to help you quickly complete this collage frame to showcase the details of your life. The card frame is removable and you can also print your favorite image to replace it.

Unique look- You can choose the wooden frame picture for living room wall decoration to hang horizontally or vertically on the wall or in the gallery; fully display your life and your family in the living room, bedroom, study, nursery, etc.; perfect as a gift for family, friends, elders and co-workers on Thanksgiving, Christmas, birthdays and holidays.
